generation_policy.note: Every tool exposed by an enabled MCP surface is declared for action admission. The MCP surface remains responsible for command policy and mutation enforcement.

tools.name: git_guidance
tools.description: Show model-facing operating guidance for git MCP workflows.

workflow.description: Optional workflow name or area to focus guidance on.

tool.description: Optional tool name for tool-specific guidance.

tools.name: git_policy_inspect
tools.description: Inspect the policy governing Git MCP operations.

tools.name: git_status
tools.description: Inspect branch, upstream, remotes, and bounded dirty-state summaries. Supports explicit work-scope, path-scoped, staged-only, and summary queries.

working_directory.description: Repository directory under an allowed root. Omitted selects the first allowed root; an explicit relative value resolves against the MCP process current directory; prefer an absolute path when the target matters.

work_scope_ref.description: Optional short-lived work-scope reference issued by git_begin_work_scope.

pathspec.description: Optional single path prefix or Git pathspec to inspect.

pathspecs.description: Optional path prefixes or Git pathspecs to inspect.

staged_only.description: Return only paths with staged index changes.

include_untracked.description: Include untracked paths in the result; defaults to true for compatibility.

format.description: full returns entries, paths returns bounded matching paths, summary returns counts and branch state.

tools.name: git_output_show
tools.description: Read a materialized Git MCP output_ref produced when a large structured result exceeds inline transport limits. Use the original git_diff next_offset inside the materialized result for diff paging; output_show offset pages the materialized JSON wrapper.

ref.description: Materialized output ref, e.g. mcp_output:<id>. Alias: output_ref.

offset.description: Character offset into the materialized JSON output.

limit.description: Maximum output characters to return; the transport hard-caps this value.

tools.name: git_changed_summary
tools.description: Return a compact dirty-state summary: tracked changed paths, untracked counts grouped by top-level directory, and optional pathspec/expected-path relevance matches. Does not include file diffs.

working_directory.description: Repository directory under an allowed root. Defaults to the first allowed root.

pathspec.description: Optional single pathspec/prefix to highlight as relevant.

pathspecs.description: Optional pathspec/prefix list to highlight as relevant.

expected_paths.description: Optional expected dirty paths or prefixes for ownership/task relevance.

untracked_sample_limit.description: Maximum untracked path samples to include across groups.

tools.name: git_repositories_summary
tools.description: Summarize multiple repositories for multi-repo handoff and publication checks, including dirty paths, latest commit, remotes, and push readiness.

working_directories.description: Repository directories under allowed roots. Omit a single working_directory to select the first allowed root; explicit relative directories use the MCP process current directory.

scope_label.description: Optional caller-supplied label for the workflow being summarized.

expected_paths_by_repository.description: Optional map from working directory or repository root to paths expected to be dirty for this workflow.

tools.name: git_workflow_record
tools.description: Record the final status of a multi-repository stage/commit/push workflow for handoff. Requires git-mcp mode=write.

scope_label.description: Required caller-supplied workflow label.

working_directory.description: Repository directory under an allowed root. Omitted selects the first allowed root; an explicit relative value resolves against the MCP process current directory; prefer an absolute path when the target matters.

tools.name: git_diff
tools.description: Show a paged Git diff for working tree, staged changes, or one commit; optionally include bounded untracked-file patches for working-tree review.

working_directory.description: Repository directory under an allowed root. Omitted selects the first allowed root; an explicit relative value resolves against the MCP process current directory; prefer an absolute path when the target matters.

pathspec.description: Optional single Git pathspec. Use pathspecs for multiple paths.

pathspecs.description: Optional Git pathspec list for multi-path diffs.

offset.description: Character offset into the complete diff. Use next_offset from the prior result to continue.

limit.description: Maximum diff characters to return in this page.

include_untracked.description: When scope=working, append bounded patches for untracked files matched by pathspec.

tools.name: git_begin_work_scope
tools.description: Acquire a durable cooperative lease for explicit paths or exclusive repository topology. Topology leases conflict with every live lease and detect out-of-band repository drift before mutation.

working_directory.description: Repository directory under an allowed root. Omitted selects the first allowed root; an explicit relative value resolves against the MCP process current directory; prefer an absolute path when the target matters.

owner_id.description: Stable caller or agent identity that owns and must release the lease.

scope_kind.description: Lease explicit paths, or exclusively lease branch/ref topology.

allowed_paths.description: Required for paths scope; forbidden for repository_topology.

base_state.description: Optional caller-supplied base state; supplied fields must match.

tools.name: git_end_work_scope
tools.description: Release a durable cooperative work-scope lease. The owner identity must match the lease.

working_directory.description: Repository directory under an allowed root. Omitted selects the first allowed root; an explicit relative value resolves against the MCP process current directory; prefer an absolute path when the target matters.

owner_id.description: Owner identity supplied when the lease was acquired.

work_scope_ref.description: Required durable work-scope reference issued by git_begin_work_scope.

scope_label.description: Optional caller-supplied audit label for this mutation.

tools.name: git_commit_paths
tools.description: Commit explicit leased paths through a dedicated temporary index. Concurrent HEAD movement is refused and shared-index reconciliation uses Git index.lock.

working_directory.description: Repository directory under an allowed root. Omitted selects the first allowed root; an explicit relative value resolves against the MCP process current directory; prefer an absolute path when the target matters.

paths.description: Exact files or directories to commit without staging them in the shared index.
